title: Lesson 16 - Can I Move My Appointment?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Northside Salon. How can I help?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Hi, I'm calling about my appointment with Rosa on Thursday at four thirty. It's under Lena Ortiz.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Let me check. Yes, I see it here.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: My work schedule has changed. Can I move my appointment?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Certainly. Rosa has an opening at five on Thursday.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: The earliest I can do is five thirty. Do you have anything available after that?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Not on Thursday. She has eleven twenty or two forty on Friday.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Friday at eleven twenty works for me.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Great. I'll move it to Friday, the eleventh, at eleven twenty.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Just to check, that's Friday at eleven twenty with Rosa, right?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Could you confirm the new time by text?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Yes. It should arrive in a moment. Your reference number will stay the same.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Thank you. Should I use the same front entrance?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Yes. Please arrive five minutes early.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Got it: Friday at eleven twenty, with Rosa, and I should arrive by eleven fifteen.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Exactly. Is there anything else I can help with?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: No, that's everything. Thanks for your help.
